**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-199`

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Package access mode is determined by owner type (org vs user) and doer relationship | authorization | Owner is org: check team permissions; Owner is user: check if doer is owner or visibility is public/limited |
| Package listing filters out internal packages by default | business_logic | IsInternal: optional.Some(false) in search options |
